value.rationale: The earlier-match position and collision backward distance are operationally natural components of the first-repeat event. A universal reverse-TP2 law for arbitrarily heterogeneous populations controls all increasing risk/cost functions, not just one covariance, and gives a sharp optimal finite-support Newton factor with exact equality classification. The root-interlacing step is structural, not a textbook substitution or arbitrary enumeration.
